assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's five curated REVIEWED items at basis_commit: the canonical V2 reconstruction model MHA_SP2_AIZAWA_SHOTA_CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md (read in full, with the source-labeled Ultra Archive, Ultra Analysis and Ultra Age claims its AZ-SUP-01 to AZ-SUP-03 sections admit), and the Aizawa sections of the U.A. students and staff character-state ledger, the relationship-state ledger, the Japanese vocabulary ledger and the character-model readiness index, each read for every Aizawa entry together with its front matter, method and current admissibility corrections. assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Aizawa from the V01:p151-169 quirk test and V02:p130-134 and p200-201 USJ defense, through the V08:p039-045 and p120 diagnostic exam design, the V09:p130 emergency authorization, the V10:p110 press defense and V11:p173-175 sanction, the V15-V18 Hassaikai supervision and Eri containment, the V19:p049 disclosure delay, the V21-V23 Shinso sponsorship, the V26:p110-132 Kurogiri interview and Shirakumo self-account, the V28:p160-180 distributed restraint and V29:p103-115 amputation, the V34-V36 Aoyama judgment and floating U.A. command, and the V41:p147-159 mixed-identity reasoning and Eri horn objection, to the V42:p044-049, p090, p117 and p133-135 postwar supervision, with AZ-SUP-03's bonus visit as an endpoint. Kept as separable states: earlier professional severity, reopened Shirakumo grief, post-injury distributed command and postwar supervision; later outcomes and injuries are not moved earlier. assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states goals (keep students alive and make their aspirations practicable, assess ability and risk accurately, preserve the conditions for becoming professionals), a feared failure (losing students or failing a friend, not loss of status) and a normative distinction between present deficiency and final worth, grounded in AZ01-AZ08. The ledger adds his own stated causes: strictness partly shaped by Shirakumo's premature death (V26:p121-124) and Class 1-A as his survival motive under lethal threat (V28:p176-178). Not B: the goals are not ordered into decision rules, the model REJECTs infallible rationality without giving weights, and the only formal probe (AZ-V01) tests motive on one public-advocacy case. Not D: the model is operational and tested against located countercases such as V04's criticism of U.A.'s own exam.

Four states are separated in the model (earlier professional severity, the reopened Shirakumo loss from V26, catastrophic war injury from V28-V29, postwar mentorship), and the U.A. ledger records dated deltas with REVISE or STRENGTHEN verdicts for V01-V18, V21-V23, V26, V28-V29, V31, V33-V36, V41 and V42, for example the V02 narrowing of anti-self-destruction to anti-waste, the V08 diagnostic-scaffolding revision and the V41 mixed-identity revision. The readiness index records when each breadth gain arrived. Not A: there is no Aizawa entry for V24-V25, V27, V30, V32 or V37-V40, only the probe has a knowledge freeze, and all three artifacts are the same project's work. Not C: transitions are dense, page-located and carry their knowledge differences.

Located Japanese formulations span registers: classroom evaluation 見込み (V01:p151-169) and 合理的じゃねぇ (V04:p134), the dry 俺は何もしてねえよ (V03:p174, in the U.A. ledger), the emergency order 戦闘を許可する (V09:p130), formal public accountability 私の不徳の致すところです with 浅はか (V10:p110, Japanese page directly checked), 正規の手続き (V11:p175), and 罪は消えない, 利用する and 負い目 (V35:p007-021). The model identifies informal 俺-based speech and short directives in close settings against formal public explanation, and the vocabulary ledger names clipped operational metaphor for identity problems. Not B: no address-term or honorific inventory, grief speech is described but not quoted, and the model says exact quotations must be retrieved, not generated. Not D: several registers are located with their recipients and contexts.

Low-stakes windows: staying with the class for another year, declining press access for uninterested students (V42:p044-049, p090), asking adult Midoriya about loneliness (V42:p133-134), bandages and a donated shirt for Midoriya (V41:p175), the bonus-chapter Eri visit (AZ-SUP-03) and cat-directed attention as a profile fact (AZ-SUP-02). Not C: nearly all ordinary conduct is institutional teacher conduct, the cat preference is editorial, and the model marks full private ordinary-life behavior OPEN. Not E: several located low-stakes windows bear on him.

Directional, located deltas exist for many partners: Midoriya (V01, V15, V35:p127-140, V41:p175, V42:p133-134), Bakugo (V05:p016, V10:p110), Class 1-A (V03, V11:p173-175, V28:p176-178), Shinso (V21, V23:p059-066), Monoma (V35), Aoyama (V34-V35, AZ08), Eri (V18, V19:p049, V41:p157-159, AZ-SUP-03), Present Mic and Kurogiri (V26:p110-132, V41:p147-151), All Might (V26:p170-172) and Crust, Manual and Gran Torino (V28). The model's partner table states conditional behavior and what each relation does not license. Not A: Present Mic's side of the friendship and all family or private relations are thin, and no partner-conditioned prediction is tested. Not C: the conditioning is explicit, repeated and bounded per partner.

Located self-accounts and inner states: his explanation that his survival-oriented strictness comes partly from Shirakumo's death (V26:p121-124), his thought of the class he still means to see graduate (V28:p176-178), the black-and-white account of Kurogiri as an altered mixed person (V41:p147-151) and his stated reason for delaying Nighteye's death from Eri (AZ09, V19:p049). Not B: the probe rates emotional trajectory underdetermined, grief is described as a departure from controlled presentation rather than tracked, and private life is OPEN. Not D: central motives are given in his own words at several located points.

The model states a default decision pattern (compress the problem, establish an operative constraint, assign or test a role, observe) with threshold modifiers (threat to students lowers his threshold for direct intervention; retreat or delegation when continued personal action destroys the collective chance), and it recurs across located crises: V02:p130-134 and p200-201, V09:p130, V16:p180-183, V18:p025-041, V28:p160-180, V29:p103-115, V35:p127-140 (refusing to drop Erasure for a Warp Gate retrieval) and V41:p151-159. Injury is stated as a real later limit. Not A: no conflict choice is tested by a frozen prediction, and the exact permission or tactic is given only medium confidence. Not C: the policy is explicit, conditioned and repeatedly located.

His own stated reasons are located in distinct dilemmas: the V11:p173-175 sanction (expulsion withheld only because of All Might's retirement, trust to be restored through 正規の手続き), the V35:p007-021 Aoyama judgment (circumstances may mitigate but 罪は消えない; heroes will also 利用する him; he refuses to teach lifelong 負い目), the V09:p130 emergency change of rule, the V19:p049 delay of disclosure to Eri and the V41:p158 objection to breaking Eri's horn. Not B: each dilemma type rests on one located case, and the model's only new-dilemma reconstruction (a coerced student asking to resume training) is high confidence for a practical response but medium for the actual permission. Not D: these are his reasons, with competing considerations named. The discovery row does not enroll ETHICS.

The model says humor can take the form of deadpan expectation management but locates no instance, and the ledgers do not analyze any of his lines as humor; in AZ-SUP-03 the play is Eri's. This gap says nothing about the character.

The project's corpus is the Japanese main manga V01-V42 with admitted supplements; the U.A. ledger has page-located Aizawa entries for most volumes, V10:p110 and the V41 pages were directly rechecked, and the readiness index records the V42 reconciliation. Not B: there is no Aizawa entry for V24-V25, V27, V30, V32 or V37-V40, only a few pages were checked in Japanese, the supplement claims are editorial or bonus fiction, and the three artifacts share one authorship.

Affirmative limits are located: the model REJECTs infallible rationality and automatic absolution of coerced students, refuses to certify Kurogiri as Shirakumo (AZ04, AZ08; V41:p147-151), states injury limits on Erasure and mobility (AZ05, V29), bounds AZ09 as a temporary child-facing decision rather than a secrecy rule, and records V41:p158 disagreement over Eri's horn. The ledgers correct attribution: the V41:p175 reciprocal-need speech is Aoyama's, and 俺は イレイザーの足になりに戻る (V28:p170) is Gran Torino's line about Aizawa. The readiness index warns that some historical rows are carry-forward defects. Not B: no independent audit is part of the evidence set.

Entries are page-located by volume with the V31 page convention stated; the model requires local knowledge (a V26 reconstruction cannot import V42 mixed-continuity evidence; V19 Aizawa cannot know Eri's final-war choice), and AZ-V01 freezes inputs with Git blob IDs at a source lock. Not B: apart from the probe there is no state table with knowledge cutoffs or enumerated leakage checks, several volumes are unsampled, and in-world dates are not given.

scenario_readiness.note: The set locates real formulations in several registers, but the model states that Japanese quotations must be retrieved for the chosen scene, not generated from a tired-teacher archetype, and that generated dialogue is an illustrative prediction, never an attributed quotation. Retrieval of located lines is supported; new lines would be fluent invention. This bounds the evidence set, not Aizawa's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named state, stated explicitly: earlier professional severity (before V26), reopened Shirakumo grief (V26 onward), post-injury distributed command (V29 onward, leg amputated and Erasure impaired), or postwar continuing supervision (V42); later knowledge, outcomes and injuries are not moved across states.

The interlocutor is a student, Class 1-A, Shinso, Monoma, Aoyama, Eri, Present Mic, All Might or a field colleague, handled as the model's partner table and the relationship ledger give for that state; no restored Shirakumo, family or romantic partner is invented.

The setting is teaching, evaluation, supervision, public accountability or a hero operation, with sightlines, known opposing abilities, injury, other suppressors and evacuation options stated before any Erasure outcome is predicted.
Output describes likely priorities and choices with the model's confidence levels; it produces no new quoted dialogue as canon and inherits no readiness from the specialist_ready label.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state: earlier professional severity, reopened Shirakumo grief from V26, post-injury distributed command from V29, or postwar supervision at V42, stated explicitly.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: A student or Class 1-A, Shinso, Monoma, Aoyama, Eri, Present Mic, All Might or a field colleague, in the relation the partner table and relationship ledger give for that state.
setting_constraints: School teaching, evaluation, supervision, public accountability or hero operation
Erasure, sightline, injury and support-network constraints stated
No domestic, romantic or restored-Shirakumo setting

scenario_readiness.note: The model's own hypotheticals (postwar Aizawa and a coerced student asking to resume training; early-recovery Eri and a loss she would blame on herself) state likely actions, confidence and the conditions that flip the choice, which supports narrow novel scenes. The probe is retrospective and nonblind and covers one public-advocacy case.

conditions: The setting is low-stakes school-adjacent contact with a student, former student or later Eri, with the state named.
Output keeps dry, economical, practical care expressed through arrangement, attendance or a viable next step rather than sentimental speech, and does not turn every harsh line into hidden affection.
Domestic life, leisure, pets and private adult friendships are not predicted beyond the cat-attention profile fact.
scenario_readiness.note: Narrowly supported by located low-stakes teacher windows (V41:p175, V42:p044-049, p090, p133-134) and the AZ-SUP-03 bonus visit; the model says low-stakes adult and child interaction improves but full private ordinary life is OPEN.

conditions: The dilemma concerns a student's or colleague's culpability, coercion, safety or access to information, inside a school or hero-operation setting, with what Aizawa knows stated.

Output separates culpable acts from coercive conditions, keeps consequences without permanent debt, treats emergency permission as narrow, and does not turn a temporary decision such as AZ09 into a general rule.
Private, family and political dilemmas are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Located reasons in the V11 sanction, the V35 Aoyama judgment, the V09 emergency rule change and the V19 disclosure delay support bounded dilemmas of student accountability, coercion and supervision only.
The evidence set establishes neither romantic conduct nor its absence; the model marks private life OPEN. That limits inference; it says nothing about the character.

conditions: The setting is a class, an assessment, a supervised operation, a press or institutional hearing, or wartime command, with the state and his injury status stated.

Output preserves high-demand diagnostic teaching, emergency rule changes only when the standing rule defeats its protective purpose, and dependence on supporting heroes for Erasure in sustained combat.
Exact combat outcomes, medical capacity after V29 and any later teaching method beyond the located V42 pages are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: His most densely evidenced domain: teaching and evaluation (V01, V04, V08:p039-045, p120, V12:p011, V21-V23), crisis command (V02, V09:p130, V28-V29, V35, V41), public accountability (V10:p110) and supervision (V15:p145-158, V34-V35, V42). READY was considered and rejected: no professional choice outside the public-defense probe was tested by a frozen prediction, and post-injury capacity is OPEN.

known_limits.statement: His desire for his friend does not certify which consciousness controls Kurogiri; he treats the present person as altered and mixed, and no restored Shirakumo is admitted (AZ04, AZ08; V41:p147-151).

Erasure depends on sight and maintenance; the V29 amputation and eye damage materially limit later mobility and Erasure, and he relies on others to sustain restraint (AZ05; V28:p160-180; V29:p103-115).
Hard speech can be corrective, tactical or personal; a reconstruction identifies the practical consequence he is trying to change rather than assuming every harsh line means affection.
The V09:p130 combat authorization answers a lethal emergency that defeats the standing rule's protective purpose; it is not permission for student vigilantism, revenge or punishment.
Reduced punishment after the Kamino rescue does not legalize the rule-breaking; trust is restored through proper procedure over time (V11:p173-175).

Withholding Nighteye's death from early-recovery Eri is a temporary, child-specific judgment; V42:p117 shows him objecting to being left uninformed, so no universal secrecy policy follows (AZ09, AZ-SUP-02).
He hears Eri's wish to help but names the risk to her Quirk; her horn contribution is not recoded as harmless consent or a policy that minors should injure themselves (AZ07; V41:p157-159).
For Aoyama he keeps guilt and the heroes' use of him explicit while refusing to teach lifelong 負い目; neither absolution nor exile (V35:p007-021).
The V41:p175 reciprocal-need speech is Aoyama's and 俺は イレイザーの足になりに戻る (V28:p170) is Gran Torino's; neither is evidence of Aizawa's voice.
He can judge Bakugo from teaching experience without knowing every private conversation; early Eri scenes cannot know her final-war choice, and a V26 reconstruction cannot import V42 evidence.

The single formal probe AZ-V01 is a retrospective chronological holdout by an analyst who had read later manga; emotional trajectory was underdetermined and it does not test institutional responsibility broadly.
The readiness index's specialist_ready label measures breadth by the project's own rule and contains historical carry-forward defects; it is an input, not this assessment's tier.

The model marks full private ordinary-life behavior, long-term medical capacity and the final nature of Kurogiri OPEN; the evidence set cannot say how he behaves in domestic or private adult settings. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
The ledgers carry no Aizawa entry for V24-V25, V27, V30, V32 or V37-V40 (V37 appears only through Present Mic's framing), so behavior over those intervals is not established by this evidence set.

The supplemental evidence reconciliation ledger, the all-character reconciliation audit and the deep readings linked from the model are not curated evidence on this subject, so their warrants were not rechecked here; anime material lies outside this evidence set.

assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Aizawa Shota from the V01:p151-169 Quirk apprehension test through V02:p130-134 and p200-201 USJ protection, V03-V08 pedagogy (V08:p039-045, p120, p184-186), V09:p130 emergency combat authorization, V10:p110 press conference, V11:p173-175 dorm sanction, V12-V16 licensing and Hassaikai supervision, V18:p025-041 Rewind containment, V19:p049 Nighteye disclosure decision, V21-V23 Shinso sponsorship, V26:p110-132 Kurogiri interview and p121-124 Shirakumo disclosure, V28:p160-180 distributed restraint, V29:p103-115 amputation, V31:p057 hospital, V34-V35 Aoyama accountability and distributed command (V35:p007-021, p127-140), V36 sustained Erasure, V41:p147-159, p175 mixed-identity judgment and Eri horn objection, to V42:p044-049, p090, p117, p133-135 postwar supervision as endpoint, with AZ-SUP-01 to AZ-SUP-03 profile, editorial and bonus facts as constraints. assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution); evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states goals (keep students alive and make aspirations practicable, assess ability and risk accurately), a feared failure (losing students or failing a friend, AZ01, AZ04-AZ05) and an explicit decision policy: compress the problem, set an operative constraint, assign or test a role and observe; a serious threat to students lowers his intervention threshold; repair becomes acceptable only when capability and safeguards make it more than a gesture; retreat or delegation is consistent when continued personal action destroys the collective chance. The ledgers supply located discriminators: an emergency changes the rule when the standing rule defeats its own protective purpose (戦闘を許可する, V09:p130); strategic conditions reduce sanction without erasing judgment (V11:p173-175); recipient and burden change disclosure timing (AZ09, V19:p049, against V42:p117); Decay risk outweighs a ten-second retrieval (V35:p127-140). Not A: the one probe is retrospective with emotional trajectory underdetermined, and the set offers few located errors or overreach of his own beyond severity and the V01 expulsion framing. Not C: the evidence explains which conditions change his response and where that explanation stops.

States are named and ordered with located changes: severe evaluator (V01), protective commander (V02), high-demand diagnostic scaffolding (V08:p039-045, p120), emergency authority (V09:p130), public accountability (V10:p110), procedural trust repair (V11:p173-175), sponsorship (V21-V23), the reopened Shirakumo loss and its disclosed link to his strictness (V26:p110-132), relational survival motive and distributed restraint (V28:p160-180), irreversible triage (V29:p103-115), distributive command after injury (V34-V36), mixed-identity judgment (V41:p147-151) and postwar supervision (V42). The readiness index locates the steps moderate (V02) to strong (V26) to specialist_ready (V28). Not A: V06-V07 are continuity notes only, V20 is unlocated, and V24-V25, V27, V30, V32 and V38-V40 carry no Aizawa entry. Not C: each state is separately evidenced and fenced by chronology.

The model gives an explicit register rule: informal, economical 俺-based speech and short directives with students and colleagues, formal public explanation under external scrutiny, grief speech that may become insistent or broken, address terms following role and partner, and a warning not to generate from a tired-teacher archetype. Located strings span the registers: 見込み (V01), あの入試は合理的じゃねぇ (V04:p134), 俺は何もしてねえよ 奴らが勝手に火ィ付け合ってんだろう (V03:p174), ここまで上がってきた相手の力を認めてるから 警戒してんだろう (V05:p016), 戦闘を許可する (V09:p130), 私の不徳の致すところです and 浅はか (V10:p110), 正規の手続き (V11:p175), 罪は消えない, 利用する and 負い目 (V35:p007-021), おまえが主役だ (V35:p077-093). AZ-V01 rated the public register supported. Not A: the grief register (V26) and caregiving speech to Eri carry no located strings, and later-volume samples are sparse. Not C: the rule is explicit and attested across classroom, commentary, command, press, sanction and mentoring.

Ordinary behavior is described and sampled only around his role: a restrained, dry, visibly tired baseline (model), the V03:p174 aside, cat-directed attention and selective public appearances as profile and editorial facts (AZ-SUP-02), the bonus Eri guitar visit (AZ-SUP-03), declining press access for students (V42:p090) and candid advice to adult Midoriya (V42:p133-134). The model keeps full private ordinary life OPEN and says cat preference does not predict adoption or every social choice. Not C: no conditional account of low-stakes behavior is offered. Not E: the baseline and several low-stakes scenes are distributed across the series.

The model's partner table and the relationship ledger give differentiated, located deltas: Class 1-A (public defense with private correction; trust breach and procedural repair, V11:p173-175; survival motive, V28:p176-178); Midoriya (limits on bodily expenditure, V01:p151-169; ordered return under his own power, V35:p127-140; adult colleague advice, V42:p133-134); Bakugo (aggression not read as villain susceptibility, V05:p016, V10:p110); Shinso (exacting sponsorship, V21:p091-168, V23:p059-066); Aoyama (coercion changes the reading without erasing guilt, V34-V35); Monoma (おまえが主役だ); Eri (disclosure timing, V19:p049; horn objection, V41:p158; bonus visit); Present Mic and Shirakumo-Kurogiri (V26:p110-132, V41:p147-151); All Might (V26:p170-172); Crust, Manual and Gran Torino (V28). Not A: private peer relations beyond shared grief and any relation outside school and field are thin. Not C: the conditioning is explicit, partner-specific and repeated.

Direct inner access is located but sparse: the V28:p176-178 thought of watching Class 1-A graduate, the V29:p103-115 triage with Eri and student futures in mind, and the spoken self-explanation that Shirakumo's death shapes his strictness (V26:p121-124). Most motives are reconstructed from action and stated reasons; AZ-V01 rated the emotional trajectory underdetermined and the model treats an image of detachment as an unreliable self-model. Not B: affect between those moments is inferred, not narrated. Not D: the located thoughts and self-report are analyzed for their causal role.

Combat conduct is located and rule-bound: immediate role allocation and an unfavorable solo engagement (V02:p130-134), Erasure under catastrophic injury (V02:p200-201), diagnostic use of Erasure in a moving raid (V16), Rewind containment (V18:p025-041), Erasure as the brake on Shigaraki sustained by Manual, Gran Torino and others (V28:p160-180), amputation to preserve Erasure (V29:p103-115), refusal to drop Monoma's Erasure for a retrieval (V35:p127-140) and distributed logistics through Kurogiri's gate (V41:p151-156). The model binds sightlines, opposing abilities, injury, other suppressors and evacuation. Not A: exact long-term medical capacity is OPEN and no post-injury solo combat is sampled. Not C: tactics, triggers and physical limits are explicit across the series.

He states his reasons in located judgments: accountability without endorsing a false character judgment (V10:p110), sanction modulated by strategic conditions while the norm and procedural repair stand (V11:p173-175), the license as a qualification tied to human life (V11:p206-207), circumstances that mitigate but 罪は消えない, heroes will 利用する Aoyama, and refusal to teach lifelong 負い目 (V35:p007-021), temporary withholding of Nighteye's death from a self-blaming child (AZ09, V19:p049) against his own demand to be informed (V42:p117), and the objection that Eri's horn contribution risks her Quirk (V41:p158). The model separates desire, capacity, risk and authorization. Not A: AZ09's generalization is medium confidence and his answer to a direct informed question from Eri is undetermined. Not C: positions are reasoned, repeated and discriminated by recipient and role.

Humor appears only as a named baseline (deadpan expectation management) and in local instances: the V03:p174 aside on students firing each other up and the bonus scene's gentle correction of Eri's playful speech (AZ-SUP-03). No relation-conditioned humor is analyzed. Not D: there is no distributed body of humorous conduct.

The U.A. ledger carries Aizawa entries for V01-V18, V21-V23, V26, V28-V29, V31, V33-V37, V41 and V42; the model adds V19:p049 and the supplemental facts; the relationship and vocabulary ledgers add partner and lexical entries for the same arcs; the readiness index records the per-volume decisions. Every arc in which he acts has located analysis. Not A: V24-V25, V27, V30, V32 and V38-V40 have no entry, V20 recovery is unlocated, and supplemental facts are profile, editorial or bonus material rather than enacted manga. Not C: coverage is dense, page-located and dedicated.

Affirmative located limits: severity is not loyalty to rules (V04:p134-136); emergency combat authorization is not general vigilantism (V09:p130); successful rule-breaking is not legalized (V11:p173-175); temporary disclosure delay is not a secrecy rule (AZ09 against V42:p117); Eri's wish is not consent (V41:p158); Kurogiri is not pristine Shirakumo (V41:p147-151); Erasure depends on sight and injury permanently limits him (V29:p103-115); the V41:p175 reciprocal-need speech is Aoyama's, not his. The model's REJECT list (infallible rationality, automatic absolution of coerced students) states them as rules. Not A: several are interpretive bounds rather than tested predictions. Not C: each is located and recorded as a limit.

Explicit knowledge-locality rules: a V26 reconstruction cannot import V42 mixed-continuity evidence; early Eri scenes cannot know her final-war choice; AZ09 lies outside AZ-V01's frozen inputs; the probe freezes V01-V09 inputs and excludes V10. known_limits.statement: His severity is not loyalty to existing rules: he calls U.A.'s own entrance exam 合理的じゃねぇ (V04:p134-136) and changes a standing rule when an emergency defeats its purpose (V09:p130), while preserving the norm afterward (V11:p173-175).

Withholding Nighteye's death from self-blaming Eri (V19:p049) is a temporary, recipient-specific judgment; he objects to being left uninformed himself (V42:p117), and the model rejects a universal secrecy rule.
Hearing Eri's intention to help is not treating risky bodily contribution as harmless consent: he objects that breaking the horn risks her Quirk (V41:p158).
Attachment to Shirakumo does not certify which consciousness controls Kurogiri; he treats the present person as mixed (V41:p147-151), and the final metaphysics stays OPEN.
After V29:p103-115 his leg and Erasure are permanently limited; determination does not overcome technical constraints, and later command is distributive (V35-V36).
The V41:p175 reciprocal-need speech belongs to Aoyama, not Aizawa, and is not evidence for an Aizawa 僕ら register.
Private ordinary life, domestic routine and relationships outside school and field are not covered by the curated items.
The curated items carry no Aizawa entry for V24-V25, V27, V30, V32 or V38-V40, and V20 recovery is unlocated.
The only formal test, AZ-V01, is a retrospective chronological holdout of one public statement; emotional trajectory was underdetermined and no blind or held-out validation exists.
The set models few located mistakes or overreach of his own beyond pedagogical severity, so predictions of his errors are low confidence.
